bots_delivery_subscription_unique.name: bots_delivery_subscription_unique
bots_delivery_subscription_unique.where: "bots"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "bots"."delivery_subscription_id" IS NOT NULL

bots_delivery_subscription_check.name: bots_delivery_subscription_check
bots_delivery_subscription_check.value: ("bots"."delivery_kind" = 'mcp' AND "bots"."delivery_subscription_id" IS NULL) OR ("bots"."delivery_kind" IN ('webhook', 'queue') AND "bots"."delivery_subscription_id" IS NOT NULL)

conversation_participants_target_check.name: conversation_participants_target_check
conversation_participants_target_check.value: "conversation_participants"."bot_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("conversation_participants"."oauth_client_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_participants"."subscription_id" IS NOT NULL)

mcp_connections_active_bot_unique.name: mcp_connections_active_bot_unique
mcp_connections_active_bot_unique.where: "mcp_connections"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "mcp_connections"."bot_id" IS NOT NULL

workspaces_personal_check.name: workspaces_personal_check
workspaces_personal_check.value: ("workspaces"."kind" = 'personal') = ("workspaces"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("workspaces"."kind" = 'personal') = ("workspaces"."name" IS NULL)
